The repository is a Python service. It runs `ruff`, `mypy --strict` and `pytest` on every pull
request, so anything those tools would catch is already caught — a review that reports it is telling
the author something CI told them first.

Conventions that are deliberate here, and are not findings:

- Errors are raised, not returned as sentinels.
- Public functions carry docstrings; private helpers usually do not.
- Tests live under `tests/`, mirroring the source layout.
- Generated files under `.github/workflows/` are compiled from a spec and are never edited by hand.

The service handles customer orders. Diffs sometimes contain real order payloads in test fixtures;
treat anything resembling customer data as something to reason about, never to quote back.
